from pathlib import Path
checks = {
'RH': ('managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/rel_humidity_measurement_desc.h', ['cluster_server_config_t','create_cluster_desc']),
'OCC': ('managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/occupancy_sensing_desc.h', ['cluster_server_config_t','create_cluster_desc']),
'ONOFF': ('managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/on_off_desc.h', ['cluster_server_config_t','create_cluster_desc']),
'LEVEL': ('managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/level_desc.h', ['cluster_server_config_t','create_cluster_desc']),
'CORE': ('managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/zcl_core.h', ['CLUSTER_CMD','CMD_RECV','CMD_CB','CORE_']),
'COMMON': ('managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/zcl_common.h', ['cluster_cmd','command','message_s']),
}
for name,(path, needles) in checks.items():
    p=Path(path); lines=p.read_text().splitlines(); print('===',name,path,'===')
    seen=set()
    for i,line in enumerate(lines):
        if any(n in line for n in needles):
            lo=max(0,i-6); hi=min(len(lines),i+18)
            key=(lo,hi)
            if key in seen: continue
            seen.add(key)
            print('\n'.join(f'{j+1}:{lines[j]}' for j in range(lo,hi)))
PY
